episodes.title: Mother of Mercy: The Call of the Horse
episodes.summary: A nun is forced to leave her quiet life at a convent when an all-powerful artificial intelligence known as Mrs. Davis enlists her to complete an epic quest.

episodes.title: Zwei Sie Piel mit Seitung Sie Wirtschaftung
episodes.summary: As she contemplates participating in the outrageous quest given to her by Mrs. Davis, Simone discovers that her ex-boyfriend, Wiley, is now part of an underground resistance devoted to destroying the all-powerful AI.

episodes.title: A Baby With Wings, a Sad Boy With Wings and a Great Helmet
episodes.summary: While pursuing a lead through the English countryside, Wiley becomes sidetracked by a bizarre endurance competition, reigniting tensions with Simone and exposing old scars and long-kept secrets.

episodes.title: Beautiful Things That Come with Madness
episodes.summary: A new mission from Jay forces Simone to honor her vows; a kidnapping exposes a conspiracy.

episodes.title: A Great Place to Drink to Gain Control of Your Drink
episodes.summary: Simone and Wiley learn the truth about Clara, the red-haired woman, from an enigmatic new source.

episodes.title: Allison Treasures: A Southern California Story
episodes.summary: After learning the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, Simone partners with Wiley and the Resistance to heist a special suit needed for its extraction; the only problem -- the suit is currently in the possession of Simone's mother, Celeste.

episodes.title: Great Gatsby 2001: A Space Odyssey
episodes.summary: Simone and Celeste go on a perilous journey; Wiley ponders on a life-changing offer from Mrs. Davis.

episodes.title: The Final Intercut: So I'm Your Horse
episodes.summary: Faced with an impossible decision, Simone's love for Jay is put to the test; Wiley earns his boots.
